description: Show the current identity: auth mode (api key, oauth, session, or anonymous), active workspace, and plan limits. Needs a signed-in Clipform account (an anonymous session is asked to sign in).
name: clipform_whoami

default_workspace_id.description: OAuth connector only: the workspace used when a tool call omits workspace_id

is_authenticated.description: True for api_key, oauth, or session auth; false for anonymous

links.description: Workspace-level dashboard links - only present for a non-anonymous caller.

dashboard.description: Dashboard home for the active workspace.

forms.description: Forms list for the active workspace.

notice.description: Anonymous sessions only: the account is a temporary preview until claimed.

plan.description: Plan limits for the active workspace

form_limit.description: Max forms in the workspace, or null if unlimited

node_limit.description: Max nodes per form, or null if unlimited

workspace.description: Active workspace, or null when anonymous

workspaces.description: Workspaces the caller can target with workspace_id - present for session (dashboard) auth and the OAuth connector

title: Who Am I
